thread:
alex.h: Quick heads-up — we need to run a controlled TF apply for tenant-networking tonight during the 20:00 UTC change window. This touches TGW routes + a small IAM role update.

maria.s: @alex.h thanks. ETA on plan readiness? any provider or module upgrades pinned?

alex.h: Plan done locally, provider pinned to hash for aws v4.55.0 in modules/networking. Lockfile changes are in the branch. I want deploy-bot to run preflight then canary apply to a staging VPC first.

deploy-bot: deploybot: starting preflight checks for branch feat/tenant-net-cutover (PR #4321)
- terraform init: ok
- backend: s3 state reachable
- lockfile diff: 1 change
- providers: pinned

jin: Can you paste the lockfile diff? want to confirm no indirect provider bumps.

alex.h: pasted: ```diff
- aws 4.54.0 -> 4.55.0 (direct)
+ registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws v4.55.0
```
Indirects look unchanged.

maria.s: Major concern: the IAM change is a minimal sts:AssumeRole adjustment to allow the new observability role. It's additive, but double-check policy scoping.

alex.h: The role change only adds a condition to existing role, not new managed policy. Here's the snippet: ```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "obs_forwarder" {
  name = "obs-forwarder-${var.env}"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [ { Action = "sts:AssumeRole", Principal = { Service = "ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com" }, Condition = { StringEquals = { "aws:SourceAccount" = var.monitoring_account } } } ]
  })
}
```

ops-lead: Sounds ok. Proposed rollout: 
1) deploy-bot preflight + plan posted to thread
2) canary apply to staging VPC (vpc-staging-3)
3) smoke test connectivity + routing to infra-tests (15m)
4) full apply to production with staggered AZs
5) rollback plan prepped before step 4

samir: For rollback: if TF apply fails or routes flake, eviction: revert to previous applied state (apply previous state snapshot), revoke new assume role by pushing emergency revert branch. Ops will run revert and escalate.

maria.s: Also recommend turning on deploy-bot's "no-auto-promote" flag so it won't push to prod automatically after staging. We want manual approval before prod.

deploy-bot: note: flag set: no-auto-promote=true for run 1767800001-canary

alex.h: I'll be online for the window. @ops-lead can you own approval gate for prod?

ops-lead: Yep, I'll be the approver. @jin please prep the smoke tests (routing check, dns resolve, egress nat). Post instructions here.

jin: Smoke tests: 
- curl from infra-test pod to backend-bastion (10.10.32.5)
- traceroute shows hop through TGW route table assoc 172
- dns: prod-service.internal resolves to correct ENI IPs
Commands: ```bash
kubectl exec -it infra-test -- curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://prod-service.internal/health
traceroute -n 10.10.32.5
```

maria.s: Also create a small eval run for embeddings pipeline that depends on the obs role, just in case of permission regressions. Takes 5m.

alex.h: Plan posted to PR comments and link to plan output: https://ci.redwood/plan/4321
Plan summary: 3 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy. Networking: add TGW route to tenant CIDR via transit attachment. IAM: modify assume role.

deploy-bot: canary apply scheduled at 20:05 UTC to vpc-staging-3. Expected duration ~6m.

samir: If canary fails, action: 1) abort full rollout, 2) revert branch and run emergency apply revert, 3) open P1 incident and notify sec if IAM issues.

ops-lead: We'll keep release notes snippet ready: "Network: add TGW route for tenant X; IAM: broadened assumeRole condition for obs-forwarder (scoped to account)." Keep wording precise.

maria.s: Confirming backup: snapshot of terraform state created at 19:58 UTC (s3:state/tenants/4321-snap), and a tfstate copy stored in ops-backups for fast revert.

alex.h: Canary started 
```
deploy-bot: applying to vpc-staging-3...
apply: success in 4m 23s
changes: 3 add, 1 change
outputs: tgw_route_id = r-abc123
```

jin: Running smoke tests now...
- curl: 200 OK
- traceroute: shows TGW hop OK
- dns: resolves correct ENI
All green.

maria.s: embeddings eval: success, no permission errors.

ops-lead: Good. Proceeding to prod approval in 10m. Reminder: staging verified, no infra alerts in last 10m.

alex.h: Pushing manual approval now.

deploy-bot: approval received from ops-lead. Starting prod apply with AZ-stagger=2 and 5m pause between AZs.

deploy-bot: apply progress: AZ1 complete, AZ2 in progress...

deploy-bot: apply failed in AZ2: error applying aws_route: "conflict: route already exists with different target"

samir: Rolling back AZ2 immediately. Running emergency revert branch.

alex.h: What's the revert command?

samir: using previous state snapshot: ```bash
terraform apply -var-file=prod.vars -state=state-snap-19:58.tfstate -auto-approve
```
Started revert.

deploy-bot: revert apply complete. Routes restored to previous state. Affected services report reduced errors.

ops-lead: Postmortem items: 
- investigate why route collision occurred (race with another customer change?)
- add preflight check to detect existing route target mismatch before apply
- update release notes: mention a temporary rollback occurred for AZ2, no user-facing downtime.

maria.s: Add sticky note for next run: run a preflight "route-target-check" script that queries aws and compares planned target. I can draft it.

jin: Also add a DRILL doc for emergency tfstate reverts in /docs/runbooks.

alex.h: Thanks everyone. I'll open a follow-up PR to add the preflight check and a unit test against mock aws responses.

deploy-bot: thread closed by deploy-bot (flag: auto-archive after 72h)
